pull.title: KAFKA-20803: Demultiplex batched persister responses once (Index batched read summary)
pull.body:
Follow-up to #22835 for [KAFKA-20803](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-20803).

- Remove repeated scans of batched `READ_SHARE_GROUP_STATE_SUMMARY` responses.
- Build one shared `PartitionResultIndex` per batch and look up each handler's result by topic ID and partition.
- Reduce demultiplexing from O(N ^ 2) to average O(N), using O(N) temporary indexing memory while preserving summary fields, errors, and retries.
